segments.text: The arms race for the leanest AI agent infrastructure just got a new contender and this one is written in Zigg.
Nullclaw is a 678 kilobyte static binary that boots in under 2 milliseconds on Apple silicon, under 8 milliseconds on
a8 GHz edge core and uses about 1 megabyte of RAM at peak. Everything is a vtable interface.
